title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Sour Berry
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only The Sour Berry Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack refreshes your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K kit with a tangy, mixed-berry profile. Inside each pack you’ll find a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container — together delivering up to 10,000 puffs when used with the Dojo Blast device. The 20mg nicotine salt formulation supports a smooth mouth-to-lung draw, while Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology help maintain steady flavour and vapour throughout use. The transparent pod makes it easy to keep an eye on levels, and the refill system keeps top-ups quick and tidy. The flavour blends tart berry notes with a touch of sweetness, echoing the bite of sour red and dark berries for a lively, moreish vape. It’s bright without being overdone, making Sour Berry a straightforward choice if you enjoy a sharper fruit profile you can return to across the day.
